data.sender_name: Agentur für Arbeit Musterlimburg (Bundesagentur für Arbeit)

items.title: File Widerspruch against the Arbeitslosengeld-Bescheid
items.quote: Gegen den Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch erhoben werden, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Agentur für Arbeit Musterlimburg, Agenturring 6, 65549 Musterlimburg. Der Bescheid gilt mit dem vierten Tag nach dem angegebenen Versandtag als bekannt gegeben.
items.computation: Versandtag as stated: Samstag, 21.11.2026. Deemed delivery (Bekanntgabe) per the letter's own rule and § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X: Versandtag + 4 days = 25.11.2026 (Wednesday) — this day is not a Sunday/holiday so no shift applies to it. The one-month Widerspruchsfrist (§ 84 Abs. 1 SGG) runs from the day after Bekanntgabe (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB): starts 26.11.2026, ends one month later on 25.12.2026 (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB) — but 25.12.2026 is Erster Weihnachtstag (public holiday, also a Friday) and 26.12.2026 (Zweiter Weihnachtstag) and 27.12.2026 (Sunday) are likewise non-business, so under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X the deadline shifts to the next working day: Monday 28.12.2026.

items.title: Report in person/online as unemployed on the first day of unemployment
items.quote: Melden Sie sich bitte am ersten Tag der Arbeitslosigkeit persönlich oder online arbeitslos, falls noch nicht geschehen.
items.computation: The letter grants Arbeitslosengeld 'ab dem 01.01.2027', implying the first day of unemployment covered by the benefit is 01.01.2027. The letter ties the registration obligation to that first day of unemployment but does not give an explicit calendar date for it, so this is inferred rather than stated outright.

warnings: The letter's printed 'Datum des Bescheids' is 20.11.2026 (a Friday) but the stated 'Versandt am' is 21.11.2026, a Saturday — an authority does not normally post mail on a Saturday, so double-check the actual posting date on your copy; if the true posting day differs, the Widerspruch deadline of 2026-12-28 could shift.

A bank IBAN (DE18 7600 0000 0004 5550 00) is printed in the footer; it is well-formed (valid German IBAN, BLZ 76000000) but this letter does not actually demand any payment to it — treat it only as the sender's own account/contact information, not as payment instructions, and never use it to pay anything unless a specific invoice from this agency says so.
